{"op":"set_pin","component":"M8","pin":"Drain","net":"vo","why":"M31 drain goes to the output Vo, not the gmc node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"C1","pin":"Neg","net":"vo","why":"Cm1 right side is Vo"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M12","pin":"Drain","net":"vo","why":"M32 drain is Vo"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"C2","pin":"Pos","net":"vo","why":"CL top is Vo"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M12","pin":"Gate","net":"n25","why":"M32 gate is the M25/M24 drain node with Ra"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M6","pin":"Drain","net":"n25","why":"M25 drain joins the M24 drain, Ra and M32 gate node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M14","pin":"Drain","net":"n25","why":"M24 drain joins the same node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"R1","pin":"Pos","net":"n25","why":"Ra connects to the M25/M24 drain node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M7","pin":"Drain","net":"nodeA","why":"left input-side folding node, separate from the right one"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M10","pin":"Source","net":"nodeA","why":"M15 source is on the left folding node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M17","pin":"Drain","net":"nodeA","why":"M13 drain is on the left folding node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M9","pin":"Drain","net":"mir","why":"M21 drain goes to the M23 mirror node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M13","pin":"Drain","net":"mir","why":"M23 drain is the mirror diode node"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M13","pin":"Gate","net":"mir","why":"M23 gate is tied to its drain"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M14","pin":"Gate","net":"mir","why":"M24 gate is tied to the M23 gate"},
{"op":"set_pin","component":"M16","pin":"Drain","net":"mir","why":"M22 drain feeds the M23 mirror node"}
]}
message.reasoning:
I'm comparing the schematic against the pipeline netlist, and noting that the netlist numbers its transistors M1 through M17 rather than matching the image's labels. Looking at the image side first, M10 is a PMOS with its source on VDD and its gate on VBP1, and its drain feeds the shared tail node of M11 and M12.

Now I'm checking the M25 and M6 drain connections, and noticing that the netlist ties both M1 and M2 gates to VDD when they should share the VBP1 net. Next I'm tracing where the M11 gate wire runs down toward the M13 drain.

Now I'm tracing the folded cascode, with M17 and M18 sharing their gate and their drains running down toward the M15 and M16 nodes.

I'm working out which nets in the image connect to which in the netlist, and I can see the wiring around M22 and the M23 gate and drain. The pipeline's M4 and M11 drain net is merged with several other nodes, so I need to split it apart.

Now I'm checking which nets meet at the gmc node, and I see M18's drain, M16's drain, and the gates of M21 and M31 all sharing it. The M8 device, the PMOS at the output stage, has its gate on that same node, while its drain should be the Vo net rather than net4, which is also where the Cm1 negative terminal and the M12 drain land.

I'm now settling on a net naming scheme: the gmc node stays as net4, covering the drains of M4 and M11 along with the gates of the output devices, while a new "vo" net takes over the output connections. The pipeline's M12 gate is wrong too; it should connect to the M25 drain net instead, which I'll call netX. Next I'm checking where Cm1's positive terminal lands, since its wire seems to run over to the M12 drain and the M16 source.

I'm sorting out which nodes the netlist's net5 actually covers. It seems to merge the M15 source, the M13 drain, the Vi- wire and the M7 drain into one node, while the Cm1 and M12 drain side should be a separate node, so I need to split that net apart.

I'm tracing how the M22 drain runs across to the M23 gate and up to the M21 drain.

I'm mapping the M24 drain and gate to the mirror net, and splitting out the M21 and M23 connections so they stop being lumped with the other nodes. The M24 drain is the one that should join the M25 drain, the R_a resistor, and the M32 gate.

Now I'm checking the remaining netlist connections: the bulk ties on the input pair look fine, and the M9 source is on VDD with its gate on the gmc node. The pair's drains split into two separate nodes, which I need to keep apart.

I'm reassigning the gate pins on M1 and M2 to a shared "vbp1" net and moving the output side onto a new "vo" net that ties M8's drain, Cm1's negative terminal, M12's drain, and the CL positive terminal together. I'm also giving M12's gate its own net, "n25", which joins M6's drain, M14's drain, and the R1 positive terminal. Next, I'm splitting the overloaded net5 so that M7's drain, M10's source, and M17's drain get their own node, leaving the M5 drain, M11 source, M15 drain, and Cm1 positive terminal on the original net.

Now I'm finishing the netlist net assignments: the M17 drain and the mirror-side devices get their own node, and the M6, M14, M12 gate, and R1 connections move onto the new output-side net.
